name: mcp-powershell-modules
description: Download the current McpSession.psm1, McpTodo.psm1, and McpContext.psm1 helper modules from the official McpServerTools bucket.
parameterSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"outputDirectory":{"type":"string","description":"Directory where the PowerShell modules should be saved"}},"required":["outputDirectory"]}
commandTemplate: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dir='{{outputDirectory}}'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sharpninja/McpServerTools/main/powershell/McpSession.psm1' -OutFile (Join-Path $dir 'McpSession.psm1'); Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sharpninja/McpServerTools/main/powershell/McpTodo.psm1' -OutFile (Join-Path $dir 'McpTodo.psm1'); Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sharpninja/McpServerTools/main/powershell/McpContext.psm1' -OutFile (Join-Path $dir 'McpContext.psm1')"
